paper_metadata.title: Excellent high-temperature strength and ductility of graphene oxide reinforced high-temperature titanium alloy matrix composite fabricated by hot isostatic pressing and heat treatment

alloy_systems.name: graphene oxide reinforced high-temperature titanium alloy matrix composite

evidence.quote: GO reinforced high-temperature titanium alloy matrix composite with excellent high-temperature strength and ductility was successfully fabricated by hot isostatic pressing and heat treatment.
Ti – Al – Sn – Zr – Mo – Si high-temperature titanium alloys are the key materials of future high-performance aero-engines
The high-temperature titanium alloy matrix composite with 0.3 wt% GO (GO/Ti – HIP) was fabricated by HIP.

property_observations.material_state: solution-treated at 1075 C and aged at 700 C

evidence.quote: GO/Ti-1075 HT had the highest 600 ◦ C tensile strength, yield strength and elongation of 749 MPa, 571 MPa and 18.5%
GO/Ti-1075 HT had the highest 600 ◦ C tensile strength, yield strength and elongation of 749 MPa, 571 MPa and 18.5%, which were 34.7%, 20.2% and 255.8% higher than GO/Ti – HIP, respectively.
the 600 ◦ C elongation of high-temperature titanium alloy with 0.3 wt% GO prepared by hot isostatic pressing (HIP) was only 5.2%, although yield strength increased by 21%

mechanisms.name: load transfer strengthening
mechanisms.material_state: solution-treated at 1075 C and aged at 700 C

evidence.quote: As the solution temperature rised, the increasing interface reaction enhanced interface bonding and the load could be transferred more efficiently. The strengthening effect of load transfer was strengthened.

mechanisms.name: in-situ interface reaction forming TiC
mechanisms.material_state: solution-treated at 1075 C and aged at 700 C

evidence.quote: The in-situ TiC layer can strengthen the interface bonding, which is conducive to transfer the load from soft matrix to high strength GO

mechanisms.name: coefficient of thermal expansion mismatch strengthening
mechanisms.material_state: solution-treated at 1075 C and aged at 700 C

evidence.quote: The difference in CTE between GO and the matrix can result in prismatic punching of dislocations at the interface, improving the strength of composite

mechanisms.name: grain boundary pinning by GO sheets
mechanisms.material_state: solution-treated at 1075 C and aged at 700 C

evidence.quote: because interfaces were difficult to move through GO sheets during grain growth

mechanisms.name: microstructure transformation from equiaxed to bimodal
mechanisms.material_state: solution-treated at 1075 C and aged at 700 C

evidence.quote: After heat treatment, the microstructure of GO/Ti – HIP changed from equiaxed structure to bimodal structure, and the transformation of microstructure can improve the strength.

mechanisms.material_state: solution-treated at 1075 C and aged at 700 C
